itemListElement.name: Web Development: From Idea to Fast, Scalable Websites and Web Applications

mainEntity.name: What does professional web development involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: It covers planning, designing, coding, testing, and operating websites or web applications—from the browser interface (frontend) to server logic, APIs, security, and technical SEO (backend).

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to develop a new website?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business website with a CMS typically takes 3–6 weeks from discovery and Figma design to launch. Custom web applications and integrations usually take 6 weeks to several months.

mainEntity.name: How much does web development cost for a business in Norway?

acceptedAnswer.text: A company website with a CMS often costs around NOK 15,000–50,000 excl. VAT, while custom web applications typically start from approx. NOK 50,000 and up. Hourly consulting rates are normally approx. NOK 800–1,500 excl. VAT.

mainEntity.name: Should we choose WordPress, Sanity, or custom Next.js?

acceptedAnswer.text: WordPress fits content-driven sites wanting a familiar editor. Sanity with Next.js excels for high performance and structured multi-channel content, while custom React/Next.js suits web applications.

mainEntity.name: Why are accessibility (WCAG) and Core Web Vitals important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norwegian businesses must meet WCAG standards so sites work for everyone. Meanwhile, Core Web Vitals measure speed and stability, affecting usability, conversions, and search rankings.

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of choosing a consultant over a large web agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: You work directly with the senior developer building your solution, avoid agency overhead, and move faster from idea to production.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer web development and consulting in the Oslo area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, I am based in Sandvika/Oslo and deliver web development, UI/UX design, and consulting via OsloWeb AS for clients across Oslo, Bærum, and Norway.
